§G专注指挥陆军的老练级领袖§!
§G代表我们国家出席联邦及[GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的老练级领袖§!
entries.en: §GVeteran Class focused on our representation in Federations and the [GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]§!

entries.zh: §G专注探索和调查的老练级领袖§!
entries.en: §GVeteran Class focused on exploration and surveying§!

entries.zh: §G专注调查异常现象、发掘遗址的老练级领袖§!
entries.en: §GVeteran Class focused on investigating anomalies and dig sites§!

entries.zh: §G专注总督技能的老练级领袖§!
§G专注内阁技能的老练级领袖§!
一位坚忍的海军上将的果敢指挥能使船员们在与敌人交战时意志更为坚定。
entries.en: The stoic presence of a decisive Admiral steels the nerves of the crew as they engage the enemy.

entries.zh: 在专职的舰队司令指挥下，舰队可以在面对敌军时保持团结一致。
entries.en: The presence of a dedicated Admiral ensures the fleet remains cohesive as it engages the enemy.

entries.zh: 在专职的海军无人机协调下，舰队可以在面对敌军时保持步调一致。
entries.en: The presence of a dedicated Admiral unit ensures the fleet remains synchronized as it engages the enemy.

entries.zh: §G专注舰队与太空海战的老练级领袖§!
entries.en: §GVeteran Class focused on fleets and naval combat§!

entries.zh: 陆军司令的指挥可以提升行星陆战的协调能力。
entries.en: The presence of a General allows for improved coordination of planetary invasions.

entries.zh: §G专注于攻击恒星基地、轨道轰炸和行星入侵的老练领袖§!
entries.en: §GVeteran Class focused on assaulting starbases, planetary bombardment ande planetary invasion§!

entries.zh: 督管专员负责通过武力维持秩序，用严格的军事化流程和远见管理星球及星区。
entries.en: Commissioners specialize in imposing order through force, governing planets and sectors with military rigor and a strong vision.

entries.zh: 战略家有更优越的大局观。比起在前线拼杀，他们更擅长于维系全军的团结，制定星系级的战争计划。
entries.en: Strategists are focused on the bigger picture. Instead of leading the battle up front, they prefer to maintain cohesion in the military and draw galaxy-spanning war plans.

entries.zh: 帝国代表是代表我们帝国出席联邦和星海共同体的利益代言人。
entries.en: As the public face of our empire, Delegates represent our interests in Federations and in the Galactic Community.

entries.zh: 外交使节负责与其他帝国维持关系，或以阴谋，或以阳略。他们深谙外交的艺术和谍战的幽深。
entries.en: Ambassadors maintain our relationships with other empires, both overtly and in more subtle ways. The art of diplomacy and the subtle craft of espionage both fall under their domain.

entries.zh: 对于这些领袖来说，维持生产配额或采购大量原材料的知识和技能宛如与生俱来。
entries.en: Knowledge and skills in maintaining production quotas or material procurement come naturally to this leader.

entries.zh: 该[owner.GetIndividualName]是专门为了帮助那些在生产过程中需要指导者而选育的。
entries.en: This [owner.GetIndividualName] was selectively bred to guide others in the production process.

entries.zh: 该单元有能力分离并删除那些低效的生产模式。
entries.en: This unit is equipped to isolate and delete inefficient production patterns.

entries.zh: 国务顾问掌管着我们帝国的收支预算，这些领袖有着深厚的经济理论功底。
entries.en: The budget of our empire is in the hand of our Advisors, a class of leaders who specialize in economic theory.

entries.zh: 探索新星球，登记新物种，遭遇新文明：这位领袖是这句格言的身体力行者。
entries.en: To explore unknown worlds, catalog new species, and encounter new civilizations: this leader is the embodiment of such ideals.

entries.zh: 探索新星球，登记新物种，遭遇新文明：这是这个无畏的[owner.GetIndividualName]的主导推动力。
entries.en: To explore unknown worlds, catalog new species, and encounter new civilizations: the guiding impulse of this intrepid [owner.GetIndividualName].

entries.zh: 探索新星球，登记新物种，遭遇新文明：这是这只无畏的单元的主导推动力。
entries.en: To explore unknown worlds, catalog new species, and encounter new civilizations: the guiding programming of this intrepid unit.

entries.zh: 星系充满了未知的谜团，而前沿学者正是来揭开它们神秘面纱的人。这些富有探险精神的研究者专精于发掘遗址、调查异常现象以及其他的秘密。
entries.en: The galaxy is full of mysteries, and Scholars exist to solve them. These adventurous researchers excel in the study of dig sites, spacial anomalies and other mysteries.

entries.zh: 分析专员奋斗在科学的第一线，他们的工作中心在于指导实验、研究新科技为帝国做出贡献。
entries.en: Being at the forefront of science, conducting experiments, and researching new technologies to better the empire is the main concern of any determined Analyst.

entries.zh: 分析[owner.GetIndividualName]奋斗在科学的第一线，他们的工作中心在于指导实验、研究新科技为[owner.GetGestaltEntityName]做出贡献。
entries.en: Being at the forefront of science, conducting experiments, and researching new technologies to better the [owner.GetGestaltEntityName] are the main concerns of an analyst [owner.GetIndividualName].

entries.zh: 分析单元奋斗在科学的第一线，他们的工作中心在于指导实验、研究新科技为帝国做出贡献。
entries.en: Being at the forefront of science, conducting experiments, and researching new technologies to improve efficiency are the main concerns for any determined analyst unit.

entries.zh: 研究者是每一个科研团队和项目背后最主要的推动力。这些人专注于研究新科技，不知疲倦地追求着新知识。
entries.en: Statisticians are the driving force behind the management of research teams and projects. Focusing on new technologies, these individuals pursue knowledge relentlessly.

entries.zh: 统计者是每一个科研团队和项目背后最主要的推动力。它们坚持不懈地追求新知识。
entries.en: Statisticians are the main driving force behind the management of research teams and projects. They pursue knowledge relentlessly.
Does not count towards Leader Capacity

entries.zh: 这位领袖是一名侦查专家，这种专业技术能帮助他们避开太空中最危险的威胁。
entries.en: This leader is an expert at reconnaissance, having the technical skill to slip past even the most dangerous entities.

entries.zh: 该[owner.GetIndividualName]专耕于侦察领域，能够最大限度地利用舰船长程传感器。
entries.en: This [owner.GetIndividualName] is specialized for reconnaissance, ensuring we get the most out of long-range starship sensors.

entries.zh: 该单元专耕于侦察领域，能够最大化利用舰船长程传感器。
entries.en: This unit is specialized for reconnaissance, ensuring we get the most out of long-range starship sensors.

entries.zh: 这位过分谨慎的领袖魔改了[Root.GetHisHer]的舰船，使得[Root.GetHimHer]可以从逃生舱指挥船只，在危险初现端倪得时候就能够舍弃船只。
entries.en: This overtly cautious leader modified [Root.GetHisHer] vessel to command the ship from an escape pod, allowing [Root.GetHimHer] to abandon ship at the first sign of danger.

entries.zh: 当舰队被摧毁时，领袖永远不会死亡。
entries.en: Leader never dies when the fleet is destroyed.

entries.zh: 在我们的学术机构里，征募管正在向最优秀、最聪明的人们颂扬服兵役的美德。在战场上获得的实践经验是课堂上无法传授的，这将会引领工程和技术的进步。
entries.en: At our academic institutions, recruiters are extolling the virtues of military service to our best and brightest minds. The practical experience gained on the battlefield can't be taught in a classroom, and should lead to advances in engineering and technology.

entries.zh: 研究者岗位提供得海军容量：§G+1§!
在这位领袖死后会被另一位具有一样的技能、人格和行为模式的仓生克隆人替代。
entries.en: A vat-grown clone with the same skills, personality and demeanor will replace this leader after death.

entries.zh: 在这位领袖停止工作后另一台与[Root.GetHeShe]具有相同技能、性格和行为模式的机器拷贝将会取而代之。
entries.en: A robotic copy with the same skills, personality and demeanor will replace this leader after [Root.GetHeShe] stops functioning.

entries.zh: 在这位领袖死后会被另一位具有一样的技能、人格和行为模式的仓生克隆[owner.GetIndividualName]替代。
entries.en: A vat-grown [owner.GetIndividualName] with the same skills, personality and demeanor will replace this leader after death.

entries.zh: 死亡时：产生当前领袖的复制品，拥有一样的技能、等级以及一半的年龄。
entries.en: Upon death: generate a copy of the leader with the same skills, level, and half the current age.

entries.zh: 这位领袖经常在深空工作，见证了真正令人惊叹的遥远之地。[Root.GetHisHer]事迹鼓舞着大众，提供了星系中稀有资源和异常事件的信息。
entries.en: Often off-world, this leader has borne witness to truly amazing, far-flung places. [Root.GetHisHer] exploits inspire the populace, providing valuable insights into rare resources and anomalous occurrences.

entries.zh: 完成异常现象时:\n$tt$所有$scientist_plural_with_icon$获得§G+300§!经验
entries.en: On Researching any Anomaly:\n$tt$All $scientist_plural_with_icon$ gain §G+300§! experience

entries.zh: 这位领袖的一生如焰火般激烈而短暂，燃烧自己，照亮后人前进的道路。
entries.en: Burn bright, die young, and leave a blazing trail for others to follow.

entries.zh: 这位领袖缺乏对宇航和机械的细心，导致需要频繁的维修和持续维护才能正常运转。
entries.en: This leader neglects the care of spacecraft and machinery, leading to frequent repairs and ongoing maintenance to keep them operational.

entries.zh: 这位细致的学者工作进展缓慢，但能产出大量的研究成果。
entries.en: A meticulous academic who works slowly, but produces incredible amounts of research.

entries.zh: 在发掘考古遗址过程中获得§G+$@trait_collective_wisdom_soc_amt|0$§!$mod_leader_scientists_society_research_produces_add$
在发掘考古遗址的时候获得§G+$@trait_collective_wisdom_soc_amt|0$§!$mod_leader_scientists_society_research_produces_add$以及§G+$@trait_collective_wisdom_ma_amt|0$§!£minor_artifacts£$MINOR_ARTIFACTS$
entries.en: Grants §G+$@trait_collective_wisdom_soc_amt|0$§! $mod_leader_scientists_society_research_produces_add$ and §G+$@trait_collective_wisdom_ma_amt|0$§! £minor_artifacts£ $MINOR_ARTIFACTS$ while Excavating Archaeology Sites

entries.zh: 一组自制的强劲扫描器，可以让这位领袖看得更远，计划更超前。
entries.en: A set of self-built, powerful scanners allow this leader to see further and plan the journey ahead.

entries.en: This delegate takes a special interest in all matters related to Galactic Commerce.

entries.en: This delegate takes a special interest in all matters related to Defense Privatization.

entries.zh: 这位代表对所有与星系间指令有关的事务表现出特别的兴趣。
entries.en: This delegate takes a special interest in all matters related to Intergalactic Directives.

entries.zh: 这位代表对所有与官僚监视有关的事务表现出特别的兴趣。
entries.en: This delegate takes a special interest in all matters related to Bureaucratic Surveillance.

entries.zh: 专精：前超光速文明立场
这位代表对所有与前超光速文明立场有关的事务表现出特别的兴趣。
entries.en: This delegate takes a special interest in all matters related to Pre-FTL Stance.

entries.zh: 这位代表对所有与星际制裁有关的事物表现出特别的兴趣。
entries.en: This delegate takes a special interest in all matters related to Galactic Sanctions.

entries.zh: $GALCOM_EFFECTS_TXT$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—对§Y星际制裁§!议案的投票权重：
这位领袖总是渴望为他人的成功热烈鼓掌。
entries.en: This leader is always eager to congratulate others for their success.

entries.zh: £diplo_weight£§Y[GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]§!§E效果§!：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—支持议案通过时获得来自提案国的1个§Y外交支持§!和5§Y信任度§!

entries.zh: 多亏了我们$LEADER$的技巧，我们博取了$WHO|Y$的一个外交支持和5信任度。
entries.en: Thanks to the skill of $LEADER$, we have managed to gain a Favor and 5 Trust with the $WHO|Y$.

entries.zh: 得益于$LEADER$的技巧，我们博取了$WHO|Y$的一个外交支持。
entries.en: Thanks to the skill of $LEADER$, we have managed to gain a Favor with the $WHO|Y$.

entries.zh: 这位领袖的行为方式中有一种……某种特殊的东西，能够赢得尊重。当这位代表发言时，每个人都会停下来倾听。
entries.en: There's a certain... something in the way this leader behaves that commands respect. When this delegate speaks, everyone stops to listen.

entries.zh: 这位领袖坚信联邦的团结力量。[Root.GetHisHer]的奉献精神对我们所有人都是一种鼓舞。
entries.en: This leader firmly believes in the uniting power of Federations. [Root.GetHisHer] dedication is an inspiration for us all.

entries.zh: 这位帝国代表能很快与联邦的新成员打成一片，知道如何让他们感受到如家一般的温暖。
entries.en: This delegate is quick to greet new Federation members and knows how to make them feel part of the group.

entries.zh: 我们可能有不同的信仰，但我们有着同一个目标、同一个联邦、同一个梦想。团结才能让我们充满力量。
entries.en: We may have different beliefs, but we share the same goal, the same Federation, the same dreams. Conflict only makes us weak.

entries.zh: 团结就是力量。这句话有时候是仅具有象征意义，而有时候则意味着我们能拥有更大的舰队。
entries.en: Unity is strength. Sometimes, that strength is inside us. Sometimes, it just means having a bigger fleet.

entries.zh: 这位领袖的眼睛、[root.species.GetEarNamePlural]和其他的感知器官可不止你看到的那么多，它们遍布全宇宙。
entries.en: This leader has eyes everywhere. Plus [root.species.GetEarNamePlural]. And other assorted sensory organs.

entries.zh: 这位领袖的摄像机、麦克风和其他的探测器可不止你看到的那么多，它们遍布全宇宙。
entries.en: This leader has cameras everywhere. Plus microphones. And other assorted sensory devices.

entries.zh: 这位行政官故作健谈之状，善于与那些口风不严的各国领袖建立联系。
entries.en: Feigning a penchant for gossip, this official is a master at forming contacts with loose-lipped leaders in high places.

entries.zh: 怨恨是一种强大的动力。这位领袖精通如何号召他人将痛苦的抱怨转变为实际行动。
entries.en: Spite can be a powerful motivator. This leader has mastered the art of turning bitter complaints into calls to action.

entries.zh: 这位狡猾的外交使节能把他察觉到的每一个细微失误都变成勒索的资材。
entries.en: This sly ambassador is quick to turn every perceived slight into blackmail material.

entries.zh: $EMPIRE_EFFECTS_TXT$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—特使§Y改善关系§!每月有 §G0.25%§!概率获得一个§Y外交支持§!。
entries.en: $EMPIRE_EFFECTS_TXT$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Envoys §YImproving Relations§! have a §G0.25%§! chance each month of acquiring a §YFavor§!

entries.en: $EMPIRE_EFFECTS_TXT$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Envoys §YImproving Relations§! have a §G1%§! chance each month of acquiring a §YFavor§!

entries.zh: 优雅的礼仪有助于这位领袖在斡旋外交协议的过程中获得有利的条件。
entries.en: Graceful manners help this leader gain favorable conditions when negotiating diplomatic agreements.

entries.zh: 市场不是战场。只有通力协作才能互惠共赢。
entries.en: The market is not a warzone: it's a party. By working together, we can all make a profit.

entries.zh: 分享知识，交换观点，协调研究，共创未来。
entries.en: Sharing knowledge. Sharing viewpoints. Sharing research. Building the future, together.

entries.zh: 这位领袖喜欢让受过专门训练的随从人员跟随[root.GetHerselfHimself]。
entries.en: This leader likes to surround [root.GetHerselfHimself] with specially trained assistants.

entries.zh: 对一些发现最好还是保守秘密为好。
entries.en: Some discoveries are best kept hidden.

entries.zh: 可能在一些人眼中的破铜烂铁在这位前沿学者眼中也是无上至宝。这位细致的领袖在彻底弄清每一件残片之前绝不会离开考古发掘现场。
entries.en: Where other academics see trash, this scholar sees treasures. This meticulous leader never leaves an archaeological site before examining every scrap.

entries.zh: 在发掘考古遗址时发现$r_minor_artifacts$矿藏机会：
entries.en: Chance to discover $r_minor_artifacts$ Deposit upon excavating an Archaeology Site:

entries.zh: 这位领袖躬行实践体力劳动，非常享受实地勘察的过程。
entries.en: This leader is no stranger to physical labor and finds field work particularly enjoyable.

entries.zh: 裂隙的召唤能得到这位前沿学者回应。
entries.en: The Rift beckons. The scholar answers the call.
